keyDefinitions.name: zisk_riscv_compliant_program_bus
keyDefinitions.role: The single public global theorem. Takes (env : OpEnvelope state m r_main)(h_bridge : env.aeneasBridgeTrust)(h_memory_construction : env.memoryTimelineConstructionEvidence)(h_known_bugs : Defects.NoKnownDefect env) and concludes env.exec_eq (a 12-conjunct AND). Proof is `refine ⟨...⟩` with 12 bullets: bullets 1-2 are just `exact h_bridge` / `exact h_memory_construction` (env-field premises passed straight through); bullets 3-12 invoke the ten per-family dispatchers, threading h_memory_construction into ldsd/misc/remaining and h_known_bugs into divu/remaining.

keyDefinitions.name: OpEnvelope.exec_eq
keyDefinitions.role: The conclusion Prop: `env.aeneasBridgeTrust ∧ env.memoryTimelineConstructionEvidence ∧ exec_eq_branch ∧ exec_eq_nomem ∧ exec_eq_rtype_binary ∧ exec_eq_itype_binary ∧ exec_eq_shift ∧ exec_eq_add_rtypew ∧ exec_eq_ldsd ∧ exec_eq_divu ∧ exec_eq_misc ∧ exec_eq_remaining`. For any one arm, exactly one exec_eq_<family> is the real channel-balance equation; the other nine are `True`. CRITICAL: the FIRST TWO conjuncts re-assert the two env-field premises, so exec_eq literally re-exports bridge+memory as part of the conclusion.

keyDefinitions.name: OpEnvelope (inductive)
keyDefinitions.role: Large inductive sum type indexed by (state, m : Valid_Main FGL FGL, r_main : ℕ). 71 constructor arms (63 opcodes + 8 variant arms: auipc_x0, jal_x0, add_via_binary/binaryadd, addi_via_binary/binaryadd, lb/lh/lw_via_static_match). Each arm's parameter list is verbatim the corresponding equiv_<OP> wrapper signature minus the shared (state,m,r_main). A sum type, not a unified record (an existential would be vacuous).

keyDefinitions.name: OpEnvelope.aeneasBridgeTrust
keyDefinitions.role: @[reducible] per-arm projection. Matches each arm to a small Prop of Valid_Main row-field equalities (e.g. beq => is_external_op=1 ∧ op=OP_EQ ∧ m32=0 ∧ set_pc=0 ∧ store_pc=0 ∧ jmp_offset2=4; ld => ind_width=8; lbu => ind_width=1; sb => ind_width=1 ∧ b_0=lane_lo r2_val ∧ b_1=lane_hi r2_val). These are the bucket-(b) decode-pin VALUES (op/is_external_op/m32/store_pc) plus store-lane bridges, NOT derivable from the ensemble (no ROM channel). Visible top-level external-trust boundary until generated Aeneas Lean is imported.

keyDefinitions.name: OpEnvelope.memoryTimelineConstructionEvidence
keyDefinitions.role: @[reducible] per-arm projection. Only the 7 LOAD arms (ld/lbu/lhu/lwu/lb/lh/lw_via_static_match) map to `LoadMemoryTimelineConstructionEvidence state bus.e1`; ALL other arms (incl. stores) map to `True`. The single visible load memory-timeline residual (#76). Stores impose no obligation here.

keyDefinitions.name: LoadMemoryTimelineConstructionEvidence
keyDefinitions.role: @[reducible] def: ∃ initialState, rows, GeneratedMemReplayFacts, priorRows, laterRows with rows = priorRows ++ entry :: laterRows ∧ MemoryPrefixStateAlignment initialState state priorRows. The construction-shaped #76 boundary: a generated replay trace contains the selected read row and the load Sail state is the prefix-replay state. Deliberately does NOT mention MemoryTimelineEvidence (so it can't be satisfied by repackaging the old residual).

keyDefinitions.name: OpEnvelope.exec_eq_<family> (10 dispatchers)
keyDefinitions.role: Each is a @[reducible]-style per-arm Prop returning the canonical channel-balance equation `execute_instruction (...) state = state_effect_via_channels ⟨bus.exec_row, [e0,e1,e2]⟩ state` (or with [] for branches, or a `do writeReg nextPC; execute` prefix for mul/div/rem) for its family's arms and `True` otherwise. Each has a companion `zisk_riscv_compliant_program_bus_<family> (env) : env.exec_eq_<family>` proved by `cases env` + `exact equiv_<OP> ...`.

keyDefinitions.name: state_effect_via_channels
keyDefinitions.role: @[reducible] def = `(bus_effect cs.execRows cs.memRows state).2`. The RHS of every canonical conclusion. By `state_effect_via_channels_eq_bus_effect_2` it is definitionally bus_effect.2. So the global conclusion is STILL stated in terms of bus_effect applied to the concrete row lists carried in the env arm's BusRows — bucket-(c).

keyDefinitions.name: BusRows
keyDefinitions.role: structure {exec_row : List ExecutionBusEntry, e0 e1 e2 : MemoryBusEntry}. Carried per arm; supplies the concrete row data that appears in both the LHS bus consumption and the RHS state_effect_via_channels. The exec-bus shape facts (length, e0/e1 multiplicities) are bucket-(c) artifacts threaded as hypotheses inside the equiv_<OP>/promises chain.

keyDefinitions.name: construction_<op>_sound (30 theorems)
keyDefinitions.role: The P4 env-elimination route. construction_sub_sound (ConstructionSub.lean:160) takes (trace : AcceptedTrace)(binding : ProgramBinding trace)(i : Fin trace.length) + ~17 honest top-level residual binders (4 decode pins, 5 Sail reads, 4 lane bridges, 3 exec-c artifacts, 1 nextPC) + the genuine `execRow` ∀-binder, and concludes the SAME bus_effect equation on `binding.stateAt i` by calling `equiv_SUB` directly. It NEVER builds an OpEnvelope — it bypasses env entirely, deriving the op-bus provider match / row shape / internal arithmetic / MemBus write-shape from trace.balanced+constraints. 30 of 63 exist (ALU/shift/W-ALU/LUI/AUIPC).

keyDefinitions.name: AcceptedTrace / ProgramBinding
keyDefinitions.role: AcceptedTrace = {length, program, witness : EnsembleWitness fullRv64imEnsemble, constraints : witness.Constraints, spec : witness.Spec, balanced : witness.BalancedChannels}. ProgramBinding = {stateAt : Fin length → SailState, mainTable + membership/component/index facts}. These are the whole-program, step-indexed substrate a trace-level theorem quantifies over; `mainOfTable trace.program binding.mainTable` projects the Main AIR rows so row-shape is ≈rfl.

keyDefinitions.name: Defects.NoKnownDefect
keyDefinitions.role: def = `∀ id, ¬ Blocks id env`. The fourth global premise; excludes the envelope from ledgered defect regions (signed-MUL witness, signed-DIV/REM dynamic witness, FENCE incomplete). Per-arm via `Blocks`; orthogonal to validity. An external-trust/defect-scoping input, retained at the trace level.

findings: (1) WHAT AN ENV VALUE IS: For a given instruction occurrence, `env` is ONE constructor of the OpEnvelope inductive — e.g. `.sub sub_input r1 r2 rd bus pins providerTable providerRow h_component h_table_spec h_provider_row h_match h_input_r1_row h_input_r2_row h_lane_rd promises`. A construction must supply, per arm: the PureSpec.<OP>Input record; the operand regidxs; a BusRows (exec_row + e0/e1/e2 concrete bus entries); MainRowPins (op + is_external_op pins on Valid_Main at r_main); for ALU arms a provider Air.Flat.Table + a provider Array FGL row + h_component/h_table_spec/h_provider_row/h_match (op-bus match); input-row lane equations; and a Promises bundle (RType/IType/Shift/Load/Store/Branch/Jump/UType Promises) carrying the Sail↔circuit bridge hypotheses. Loads additionally carry mem : Valid_Mem, a second mem-row var/env, h_mainEval/h_providerEval/h_msg cross-AIR MemBus-eval equalities, addr/sel/wr facts. Stores carry a Clean MainRowWithRom var + Spec + per-byte preserved-RMW memory facts (h_m1..h_m7).

(2) HOW exec_eq DECOMPOSES: exec_eq is a 12-conjunct AND. Conjuncts 1-2 (`env.aeneasBridgeTrust`, `env.memoryTimelineConstructionEvidence`) are ENV-FIELD PREMISES re-exported into the conclusion — the global theorem discharges them by `exact h_bridge` / `exact h_memory_construction`, i.e. they are assumed and echoed, NOT proved. Conjuncts 3-12 are the ten per-family `exec_eq_<family>` Props, each PROVED by its dispatcher (`exact equiv_<OP> ...`). For any single arm exactly one of conjuncts 3-12 is the real `execute_instruction (...) state = state_effect_via_channels ⟨exec_row,[e0,e1,e2]⟩ state` equation and the rest are `True`. So the ONLY genuinely-proved content is the one matching family equation; bridge and memory are pure assumptions.

(2b) WHICH FAMILIES CONSUME WHICH PREMISE: branch/nomem/rtype_binary/itype_binary/shift/add_rtypew dispatchers take ONLY env. ldsd/misc/remaining additionally take h_memory_construction (used only on their 7 load arms via loadMemoryTimelineEvidence_of_constructionEvidence; stores ignore it). divu (`_except_known_defects`) and remaining additionally take h_known_bugs. DIVU's defect hypothesis is now vestigial (the comment says DIVU closes from row/range/op-bus evidence; h_known_bugs retained only for shared dispatcher shape).

(3) ENV IS PER-INSTRUCTION, NOT WHOLE-PROGRAM: env is a SINGLE OpEnvelope value = one instruction occurrence at one Main row index r_main, over one Sail `state`. It carries no notion of trace length or step sequence. Therefore a trace-level statement MUST quantify over steps and build one env per step: the honest export theorem ranges over `∀ i : Fin trace.length` (using AcceptedTrace + ProgramBinding) and, for each i, must either (a) construct the matching OpEnvelope arm from the trace row and discharge its premises, or (b) bypass env entirely as the construction_<op>_sound theorems already do (they take (trace, binding, i) and call equiv_<OP> directly, never materializing env). Route (b) is the demonstrated env-elimination path: 30/63 opcodes have it, deriving op-bus-match/row-shape/internal-arithmetic/MemBus-shape from trace.balanced+constraints and leaving ~17 honest top-level residual binders + the genuine execRow ∀-binder.

(3b) THE TRACE-LEVEL TARGET shape (per RESEARCH_76_DESIGN end-state): `compliant committedTrace h_balanced h_aeneas h_mem_boot h_known_bugs` with NO env. env is SCAFFOLDING (derivable from a committed trace row); the irreducible external-trust inputs that survive are: proof-system BalancedChannels (already inside AcceptedTrace.balanced/witness), the aeneas bridge / decode-pin values (bucket-b, program/ROM residual = aeneasBridgeTrust today), program-boot memory binding (the load timeline construction residual, #76), and NoKnownDefect. The construction theorems show env-removal is real, not laundering, because the derived facts come from trace.balanced+constraints, not from new caller hypotheses.

(4) BUCKET-(c) EXEC-BUS ARTIFACTS ARE NOT ENV FIELDS — they are SEPARATE hypotheses inside the construction/equiv chain. In construction_sub_sound they are explicit top-level binders: `execRow : List (ExecutionBusEntry FGL)` (genuine ∀-binder, MUST stay universal for anti-vacuity), `h_exec_len : (busSub ...).exec_row.length = 2`, `h_e0_mult : exec_row[0]!.multiplicity = -1`, `h_e1_mult : exec_row[1]!.multiplicity = 1`. They are pure bus_effect/ExecutionBusEntry bookkeeping with NO ZisK circuit counterpart. In the env path they are folded into the per-arm Promises bundle / BusRows. They do NOT block env-elimination (the construction theorems already discharge env while carrying them as residuals), but they CANNOT be DERIVED away without retiring bus_effect itself — that is the separate P6 work (`eliminated when bus_effect is retired`, filed P6-style per PLAN_ENDGAME_P4_SPINE.md). So: env-elimination (P5/P6-OpEnvelope-retirement) and bus_effect-retirement (true P6) are independent; the bucket-(c) artifacts ride along as honest residuals until bus_effect goes.

VACUITY GUARD already encoded: the SPINE plan's §4.9 anti-vacuity invariant requires execRow to be universally quantified — hard-coding exec_row = [] would make h_exec_len (0=2) false and the construction theorem vacuously true. This is the cardinal-sin guard the recursive TrustGate binder gate (bin/TrustGate/Main.lean, baseline-construction-theorem-binders.txt) enforces by surfacing every top-level binder and forbidding *RowBinding/MainRowProvenance deep records that could hide a bucket-(a)/(c) fact.
